business_model.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K Item 1 Business)
business_model.claim: Stepan produces specialty and intermediate chemicals that are sold to other manufacturers, not directly to retail customers.
quotes: Stepan Company, which was incorporated under the laws of the state of Delaware on February 19, 1959, and its subsidiaries produce specialty and intermediate chemicals, which are sold to other manufacturers and used in a variety of end products.
The Company does not sell directly to the retail market but sells to a wide range of manufacturers in many industries and has many competitors.

business_model.basis: stated in the cited item (10-Q MD&A Overview)
business_model.claim: The company reports three segments: Surfactants (71 percent of net sales), Polymers (25 percent), and Specialty Products (four percent) for the first nine months of 2026.
quotes: Surfactants – Surfactants, which accounted for 71 percent of consolidated net sales for the first nine months of 2026, are principal ingredients in consumer and industrial cleaning and disinfection products such as detergents for washing clothes, dishes, carpets, floors and walls, as well as shampoos and body washes.
Polymers – Polymers, which accounted for 25 percent of consolidated net sales for the first nine months of 2026, include polyurethane polyols, polyester resins and phthalic anhydride.

Specialty Products – Specialty products, which accounted for four percent of consolidated net sales for the first nine months of 2026, include flavors, emulsifiers and solubilizers used in food, flavoring, nutritional supplement and pharmaceutical applications.

business_model.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K Item 1 Business)
business_model.claim: Surfactants serve as the basic cleaning agent in detergents, personal care products, and industrial applications including agricultural emulsifiers and oilfield surfactants.
quotes: Surfactants are the basic cleaning agent in detergents for washing clothes, dishes, carpets, fine fabrics, floors and walls.

Commercial and industrial applications include emulsifiers for agricultural products, emulsion polymers such as floor polishes and latex foams and coatings, wetting and foaming agents for wallboard manufacturing and surfactants for oilfield applications.

business_model.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K Item 1 Business)
business_model.claim: Polymers include polyurethane polyols for rigid foam insulation in construction, polyester resins for coatings/adhesives/sealants/elastomers, and phthalic anhydride for resins and plasticizers.
quotes: Polyurethane polyols are used in the manufacture of rigid foam for thermal insulation in the construction industry. They are also a raw material base for coatings, adhesives, sealants and elastomers (CASE) applications.

Phthalic anhydride is used in polyester resins, alkyd resins, and plasticizers for applications in construction materials and components of automotive, boating, and other consumer products and internally in the production of polyols.
